component.name: MyLongboxDB
component.summary: Catalog and search your comic book collection

description.p: MyLongboxDB keeps track of a physical collection of comic books, magazines, and collected editions, with photos of their covers, in one file on your computer.

ul.li: Record every detail: creators, characters, story arcs, grades and slab certificates, signatures, where each book is stored, and what you paid
Search every field at once, with tolerance for typos, or combine filters on any field
Keep any combination of filters as a shelf in the sidebar, and hide the sidebar entries you do not use
See the gaps in your runs, your key issues, and possible duplicates
Follow what each book is worth over time, in dollars, gold, or bitcoin
Add front and back cover photos, including iPhone HEIC photos, cropped and straightened in the app
Import from a spreadsheet, and export everything to CSV and JPEG at any time
Save a checked backup copy at any time, with a safety copy kept before any risky change

description.p: MyLongboxDB never connects to the internet. It has no networking code, blocks itself from opening internet connections when it starts, and can change files only in its own folders and in files you choose. Nothing you record leaves your computer.
